_note: Every item in the MVP: its one route (how it is acquired), its one mechanic, and the numbers the rules read. crates/core/src/items.rs reads this file (compiled in) and its tests hold CW-6, CW-7 and CW-8 over it. Names and descriptions are in data/strings.json under item_<id> and item_<id>_about. Routes and mechanics are ids the story (M5) and the duel (M1) act on, not reader text. 'value' is in coins: the merchant sells at it and buys at merchant.buys_at_pct of it. 'grid' places a free-hand item in Select Item's grid (6 across, 3 down); 'slot' places an armour piece; 'quick' says it can go on 1, 2 or 3.
